# grow.contact

> grow.contact is an agent-native website agency that builds marketing sites for AI startups, agent platforms, and developer tools — engineered to be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews from day one. Fixed price. 48-hour delivery. Score-first proof.

grow.contact is not affiliated with grow.com (a B2B sales platform). This is grow.contact — the GEO and agent-native web agency operated by Gudmundur Eyberg Kristjansson.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://grow.contact/): Agency overview, live agent-readability dashboard, free instant scan tool.
- [Services](https://grow.contact/services): Three services — Agent-Native Website Build, Agent Readability Audit, Schema Optimization.
- [Process](https://grow.contact/process): Five-step workflow from brief to live agent-readable site in 48 hours.
- [Work](https://grow.contact/work): Client case studies with before/after agent-readability scores.
- [Pricing](https://grow.contact/pricing): Fixed pricing — Starter $2,400 (1 page, 48 hours), Growth $4,800 (up to 5 pages).
- [Leaderboard](https://grow.contact/leaderboard): Open dataset — agent-readability scores for 390+ AI companies across infra, models, agents, and dev tools. Filterable by category and failing signal.
- [Leaderboard methodology](https://grow.contact/leaderboard/methodology): Scoring weights, pass thresholds, refresh cadence, dataset license (CC BY 4.0), and citable headline statistics.
- [Leaderboard JSON API](https://grow.contact/api/public/leaderboard.json): Full dataset as JSON. CORS-open, CC BY 4.0. Includes headline_stats with quotable percentages for journalists and analysts.
- [Journal](https://grow.contact/blog): GEO guides, agent-native web patterns, and AI citation research.

## Tools

- [Agent Readability Check](https://grow.contact/check): Free URL scanner. Scores any site across Semantic HTML, JSON-LD, llms.txt, Citability, Page Speed, and Protocol Discovery. No signup required.
- [grow CLI](https://grow.contact/cli): Zero-dep Node CLI (`npx @grow-contact/cli check <url>`). Same six-signal score as the web scanner, CI-friendly `--fail-under` flag. MIT licensed.

## Full Content

- [llms-full.txt](https://grow.contact/llms-full.txt): Full site content in markdown for agents requiring complete context.
